intent: An ancient Grashan court battle gown in pale ruin stone, old bronze and moss, reading from the high camera as a pale stepped bell: a fitted cuirass over a moss sash, a wide four-tiered skirt of stone lames flaring from a narrow waist to a broad hem, and a centred bronze-ridged crest with a moss veil.
requests: A tapered or cone shape for skirts: a bell has to be built from stepped boxes, so the flare comes in hard steps rather than one fall.
A worn bronze that keeps its colour under the night preset; the old bronze trim reads almost brown at this light.
A moss material with a little variation, so the thin hems and seams read as growth rather than painted green lines.
Small pauldrons, as the direction asked: nothing may rise or stand out at the shoulder, so the sleeve is kept close to the arm instead.
